pr_title: HTTP/3: Change alt-svc protocol to h3 and add upgrade test

issue_context.title: HTTP/3: Test alt-svc upgrade from HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 to HTTP/3
issue_context.body:
Currently blocked from being added to https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/34104

Blocked because HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 require suppression of cert error using callback, and HTTP/3 errors when there is a callback.

See https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/55193 and https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/55192
comments:

review_comments: I was testing the ALPN code with similar values. I think we should include both h3 and h3-29 for compat for at least a milestone, that's really common on websites I've checked. h3 alpn didn't work with HttpClient yet.

I found the opposite with HttpClient: h3-29 doesn’t work and h3 does. That’s why I changed it in this PR.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/d3a8a19db1d8df774927f35f3f6d393ffbd075cb/src/libraries/System.Net.Http/src/System/Net/Http/SocketsHttpHandler/HttpConnectionPool.cs#L1118

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/303201/126086373-7f79a0d4-c697-47b1-affd-b187afc4449f.png)

If HttpClient and major browsers support h3 then I think it's fine to completely switch in RC1.

Doesn't the ALPN setting need to be updated to match?

HttpClient is being inconsistent and using h3 in the altsvc but not as it’s alpn https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/55894?notification_referrer_id=MDE4Ok5vdGlmaWNhdGlvblRocmVhZDIxODY4Nzc0MTY6MzAzMjAx#issuecomment-882839687
